.github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "4"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: line-tables-only
  JOPE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 3
    outputs:
      rust: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.rust }}
      emitters: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.emitters }}
      inputs: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.inputs }}
      python: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.python }}
      e2e: ${{ steps.lane.outputs.e2e }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane changes --output "$evidence" --backend none -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh changes
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  hygiene:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane hygiene --output "$evidence" --backend unittest -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh hygiene
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  rust-check:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane rust-check --output "$evidence" --backend rust -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh rust-check
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  rust-test:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      JOPE_PARITY_STRICT: "1"
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      RAYON_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane rust-test --output "$evidence" --backend nextest --junit "$evidence/junit.xml" -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh rust-test
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  emitters:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.emitters == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      JOPE_PARITY_STRICT: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane emitters --output "$evidence" --backend rust -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh emitters
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  inputs:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.inputs == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane inputs --output "$evidence" --backend none -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh inputs
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  python:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.python == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane python --output "$evidence" --backend pytest --junit "$evidence/junit.xml" -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh python
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  e2e-smoke:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.e2e == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Run declared lane and retain receipt
        id: lane
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/ci-evidence/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/$GITHUB_JOB"
          python3 deploy/ci/receipt.py --lane e2e-smoke --output "$evidence" --backend none -- bash deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh e2e-smoke
      - name: Upload current lane evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/ci-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/${{ github.job }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

  aggregate:
    needs: [changes, hygiene, rust-check, rust-test, emitters, inputs, python, e2e-smoke]
    if: always()
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Download this run and attempt only
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-*
          path: target/ci-download/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Validate every required result
        if: always()
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJson(needs) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="target/ci-aggregate/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir -p "$output"
          printf '%s\n' "$NEEDS_JSON" > "$output/needs.json"
          python3 deploy/ci/aggregate.py --receipts "target/ci-download/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --needs "$output/needs.json" --output "$output/aggregate.json"
      - name: Upload aggregate inventory
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-aggregate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/ci-aggregate/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30
.github/workflows/full-main.yml:
name: full-main-cpu
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: line-tables-only
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "4"
  JOPE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
  JOPE_PARITY_STRICT: "1"
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  RAYON_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
  MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"

# One fixed full slot serializes jobs on xbabe2. No concurrency group discards pending pushes.
jobs:
  cpu:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-full-cpu]
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Persistent Cargo target
        uses: ./.github/actions/cargo-target
      - name: Runner provenance and approved resources
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Execute every declared CPU family independently
        run: |
          python3 deploy/ci/full-main.py run --output "target/full-cpu/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - name: Inventory every result including failed or missing families
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 deploy/ci/full-main.py summarize --output "target/full-cpu/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - name: Upload fresh run evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: full-cpu-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/full-cpu/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30
.github/workflows/main-guard.yml:
name: main-guard

# Until the organisation is on the Team plan (branch protection on a private repository), this
# workflow is the guard: every commit that reaches main must belong to a merged pull request.
# A violation opens an issue and fails the run.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-full-cpu]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      # This workflow stands in for branch protection until the org is on the Team plan, and it
      # now runs on the self-hosted lane, so it is worth the extra minute to prove the runner is
      # the one this commit describes before trusting its verdict.
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Runner provenance
        uses: ./.github/actions/runner-provenance
      - name: Every commit on main belongs to a merged pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          AFTER: ${{ github.sha }}
          PUSHER: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$BEFORE" ] || [ "$BEFORE" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
            commits=$AFTER
          else
            # No `|| echo "$AFTER"` fallback: that silently narrowed the guard to the head commit
            # whenever the API call failed, which is the one case where it most needs to be loud.
            commits=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/compare/$BEFORE...$AFTER" --jq '.commits[].sha') \
              || { echo "main-guard: could not list the pushed commits; refusing to pass" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bad=""
          for sha in $commits; do
            merged=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$sha/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null)] | length') \
              || { echo "main-guard: could not look up pull requests for $sha; refusing to pass" >&2; exit 1; }
            # An empty or non-numeric answer makes `[ "$merged" -eq 0 ]` exit 2, which reads as
            # false inside an if -- so an API hiccup silently excused the commit it was checking.
            case $merged in
              ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "main-guard: unexpected pull-request count '$merged' for $sha" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            if [ "$merged" -eq 0 ]; then bad="$bad $sha"; fi
          done
          if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
            body=$(printf 'Pushed by %s. Commits on main without a merged pull request:%s\n\nLand work through a pull request (ci.yml green) instead of pushing to main.' "$PUSHER" "$bad")
            gh issue create -R "$REPO" --title "main-guard: commit(s) pushed to main without a merged pull request" --body "$body"
            echo "$body"; exit 1
          fi
          echo "ok: every pushed commit belongs to a merged pull request"
.github/workflows/release.yml:
name: release

# Release engineering (plan "CI and testing" → "Release engineering"; ADR-0001 step 5 for the history
# gate that precedes any push). Runs on hosted runners only, on `v*` tags:
#   version consistency (tag == workspace == python) → `jope` built inside rust:1.97.1-bookworm
#   (glibc 2.36, the appliance bound) → jope-build-receipt (max glibc 2.36, no GPU libraries) →
#   wheel (`uv build` from python/) → SBOMs (syft SPDX for the tree, cargo-cyclonedx for the Cargo
#   graph) → build provenance attestation → git-cliff notes → GitHub release with every artefact.
# Every third-party action is pinned to a commit SHA (the organisation's allowed-actions list).
# Model bundles (models/PINNED) and datasets (datasets/manifest.json) are versioned separately and
# only referenced by hash in release-manifest.json; no weights or datasets are downloaded here.

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: line-tables-only
  BUILDER_IMAGE: rust:1.97.1-bookworm
  MAX_GLIBC: "2.36"

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout (full history for the changelog)
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Version consistency (workspace == python == tag)
        run: bash deploy/ci/version-consistency.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"

      - name: Rust cache
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          key: release

      - name: Build jope in ${{ env.BUILDER_IMAGE }} (glibc 2.36)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder" dist
          docker pull -q "$BUILDER_IMAGE"
          docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' "$BUILDER_IMAGE" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/image-id.txt"
          # RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN pins the image's own toolchain (it equals rust-toolchain.toml's channel;
          # the receipt records both and whether they match). The checkout is mounted read-write only
          # for target/; the cargo home is a runner temp dir, never the tree.
          docker run --rm --network host \
            --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
            -e HOME=/work -e CARGO_HOME=/cargo-home -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/target/bookworm \
            -e RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.97.1 -e CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always \
            -e CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 -e CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only \
            -v "$PWD:/work" -v "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-home:/cargo-home" -v "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder:/builder" \
            -w /work "$BUILDER_IMAGE" \
            bash -euo pipefail -c '
              (ldd --version | head -n1) > /builder/builder-libc.txt
              rustc -vV > /builder/rustc-vV.txt
              printf "%s\n" "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN-}" > /builder/rustup-toolchain.txt
              cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 > /builder/metadata.json
              cargo build --release --locked -p jope-cli --bin jope --message-format=json-render-diagnostics > /builder/build.jsonl
            '
          binary=$(cargo run -q --locked -p jope-ci -- cargo-artifact select --package jope-cli --bin jope \
            --metadata "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/metadata.json" --messages "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/build.jsonl" \
            --path-map /work "$PWD")
          cp "$binary" "dist/jope-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/builder-libc.txt" "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/rustc-vV.txt"

      - name: Build receipt (glibc ≤ ${{ env.MAX_GLIBC }}, no CUDA/LibTorch libraries)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # jope-build-receipt (crates/jope-engine/src/bin) writes jope.product_evaluator_build.v1 and
          # fails the release when the binary needs a newer glibc or links a GPU library.
          cargo run --quiet --locked -p jope-parallel --bin jope-build-receipt -- \
            --binary "dist/jope-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" \
            --source-dir . \
            --output "dist/jope-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.build-receipt.json" \
            --lineage "jope-cli-$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --rustc-vv "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/rustc-vV.txt" \
            --rustup-toolchain "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/rustup-toolchain.txt" \
            --profile release \
            --command "docker run --network host $BUILDER_IMAGE ($(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/builder-libc.txt")): cargo build --release --locked -p jope-cli" \
            --builder-image "$BUILDER_IMAGE@$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/builder/image-id.txt")" \
            --max-glibc "$MAX_GLIBC" \
            --forbid-gpu-libraries
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); b=r["bounds"]; print(json.dumps(b, indent=1)); sys.exit(0 if b.get("passed") else 1)' \
            "dist/jope-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.build-receipt.json"

      - name: uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@bec219d24cd3e171d82865faccec33120bb574f4 # v10.1.0

      - name: Wheel and sdist (python/)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd python && uv build)
          cp python/dist/*.whl python/dist/*.tar.gz dist/
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/wheel-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/wheel-venv/bin/pip" install --quiet --no-deps dist/*.whl
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/wheel-venv/bin/python" -c 'import jope; print("import jope ok")'

      - name: Install git-cliff and cargo-cyclonedx
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@dfae9bf3d6f6c6f20ef4ebb3486c01a51341ff12 # v2.87.18
        with:
          tool: git-cliff@2.14.1,cargo-cyclonedx@0.5.9

      - name: SBOM (syft, SPDX JSON, whole tree)
        uses: anchore/sbom-action@3ad7283483fc7af8ff2b4ea19663c2d5ca935e26 # v0.24.2
        with:
          path: .
          format: spdx-json
          output-file: dist/jopedime-${{ github.ref_name }}.spdx.json
          artifact-name: sbom-spdx
          upload-artifact: false
          upload-release-assets: false

      - name: SBOM (cargo-cyclonedx, one CycloneDX 1.5 document per workspace crate)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # cargo-sbom is not in taiki-e/install-action's manifests; cargo-cyclonedx is the Cargo-native SBOM.
          # It writes cyclonedx.json beside every member manifest; collect them under dist/ by crate directory.
          cargo cyclonedx -q --format json --spec-version 1.5 --override-filename cyclonedx
          while IFS= read -r file; do
            crate=$(basename "$(dirname "$file")")
            mv "$file" "dist/$crate-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.cdx.json"
          done < <(find crates -name cyclonedx.json)
          ls dist/*.cdx.json

      - name: Changelog (git-cliff, this tag)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git cliff --config cliff.toml --latest --strip header -o "dist/CHANGELOG-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.md"
          test -s "dist/CHANGELOG-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.md"

      - name: Release manifest and checksums
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_SHA" <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, sys, tomllib
          tag, sha = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
          def digest(path):
              return hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest() if os.path.exists(path) else None
          with open("Cargo.toml", "rb") as f:
              version = tomllib.load(f)["workspace"]["package"]["version"]
          pinned = [l.strip() for l in open("models/PINNED")] if os.path.exists("models/PINNED") else []
          manifest = {
              "schema": "jope.release-manifest/v1",
              "tag": tag,
              "git_sha": sha,
              "crate_version": version,
              "builder_image": os.environ["BUILDER_IMAGE"],
              "max_glibc": os.environ["MAX_GLIBC"],
              "models_pinned": [b for b in pinned if b and not b.startswith("#")],
              "models_manifest_sha256": digest("models/manifest.json"),
              "datasets_manifest_sha256": digest("datasets/manifest.json"),
              "artifacts": {name: digest(os.path.join("dist", name)) for name in sorted(os.listdir("dist"))},
          }
          json.dump(manifest, open(f"dist/release-manifest-{tag}.json", "w"), indent=2)
          print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
          PY
          (cd dist && sha256sum -- * > "SHA256SUMS-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.txt" && cat "SHA256SUMS-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.txt")

      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/jope-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            dist/*.whl
            dist/*.tar.gz
            dist/*.spdx.json
            dist/*.cdx.json

      - name: Upload artefacts (30 days)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --title "JopeDime $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --notes-file "dist/CHANGELOG-$GITHUB_REF_NAME.md" \
            --verify-tag \
            dist/*
.github/workflows/runner-admission-probe:
name: runner-admission-probe
# Manual negative operational proof. Expected outcome is rejection, not a green job.
# Operators verify the hook denial, absent bypass marker and terminated container.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
jobs:
  reject-fast:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-ci]
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Must never execute after admission denial
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo 'ADMISSION_POLICY_BYPASS'
          exit 1
  reject-main:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, jope-full-cpu]
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Must never execute after admission denial
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo 'ADMISSION_POLICY_BYPASS'
          exit 1
.github/workflows/weekly.yml:
name: weekly

# Plan WP12 / "CI additions": the weekly regression suite on the self-hosted xbabe2 runner —
# one Golden42 panel cell, encoder parity, policy parity, the emitter bench — and the restore
# drill from a fresh directory. Both scripts fail with the exact missing prerequisite; nothing is
# skipped silently. Receipts are uploaded as artifacts.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: weekly
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  AWS_REGION: us-east-2

jobs:
  regression-suite:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, xbabe2-gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 720
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Toolchain (from rust-toolchain.toml)
        run: rustup show active-toolchain
      - name: AWS credentials (JopeDimeCiRead via OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.JOPE_DIME_CI_READ_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      - name: Pinned models and Golden42 datasets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jope=$(cargo run -q --locked -p jope-ci -- cargo-artifact build --package jope-cli --bin jope)
          "$jope" models fetch --pinned
          "$jope" datasets fetch golden42
      - name: Regression suite
        env:
          RECEIPTS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/regression
          JOPE_REGISTRY: ${{ github.workspace }}/datasets/by-id
        run: bash deploy/ci/regression-suite.sh all
      - name: Upload receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: regression-suite-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: target/regression
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

  restore-drill:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, xbabe2-gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Toolchain (from rust-toolchain.toml)
        run: rustup show active-toolchain
      - name: AWS credentials (JopeDimeCiRead via OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.JOPE_DIME_CI_READ_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
      - name: Restore drill (fresh directory)
        env:
          RECEIPTS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/restore-drill
        run: bash deploy/ci/restore-drill.sh
      - name: Upload receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: restore-drill-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: target/restore-drill
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
